name: 轻量档案卡
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity WeChat miniapp UI design comparison for 趣搭局, a Chinese local interest meetup product. Produce ONE image with TWO complete portrait mobile screens side by side, each screen ratio 393:852, equal height, flat front-on, no device hardware, no perspective, no outside decorative scene. Left screen 我的, right screen 组局详情. Small caption above screens states concept letter/name; small bottom outside caption "示例内容 · 视觉方案". This is interface design not a promotional poster.
Preserve established palette: page white #FFFFFF, shallow gray-white card #F7F8FA, normal text near black #1F1F1F, blue #1C4A9C for regular controls/icons, orange #FA704B ONLY main action and center publish. Light blue small tags. NO purple, beige page backgrounds, green, black page backgrounds. Chinese system sans, readable realistic mobile type 14-17px body, 22-26px heading. Spacious rhythmic breathing room but no huge empty holes. Top iOS safe area plus WeChat capsule on right, navigation controls avoid capsule. Unified thin outline icons.

Input image is topology reference ONLY: copy the dimensional personal identity card with upper card, protruding decorative dimensional element, and overlapping foreground intro panel, NOT its purple palette, levels, score, benefit claims. Use a small sculpted blue/orange paired-ticket motif not achievement badge/star/shield. Avatar authentic illustrative portrait. Name 周末探险家. Bio exact "喜欢散步、桌游，也想认识新朋友。" tags "桌游" "城市漫步" "陪拍". Editable card button "编辑资料". Messages icon upper right-left of native capsule, tiny unread red dot. No fake membership level, join duration, scores, verified claims or stats. Under identity card prioritize "我的报名" and "我发起的", then "我的收藏" "费用记录" "客服与帮助" "设置"; no coupons, service center, order shortcuts. Profile white fixed nav bottom EXACT 首页 / 发布 / 我的, middle orange circle + raised precisely centered, blue profile icon, labels black/gray.
Right meetup exact title "周六桌游局，新手也能来", category 桌游, tags "轻策略" "新手友好", inviting authentic cafe boardgame photo of Chinese young adults. Host 阿橙. Example metadata "周六 14:00" "静安寺" "4 / 6人" "免费". Description "带你从轻策略开始，一起认识新朋友。" Explain "局主审核" and "通过后可查看集合细节". No generic consult chat button because only host may invite accepted chat from applicant. Bottom fixed white action bar with small "免费" at left and wide orange "申请加入" button. Detail can scroll but screenshot should show essentials + start of more description, no nav tabs on detail. No trust guarantees, refunds invented, no member stats. Designs must show recognizable UI sections and semantic controls, not text baked inside photos.
Composition variant C: Profile structure: compact white header, identity upper card on white with blue 2px edge, avatar and name at top-left, sculpted ticket motif attached small at top-right; a shallow graywhite foreground bio panel overlaps lower edge with curved seam, blue hairline, no solid large blue block. Identity250px high. Below a single wide white-gray "我的组局" area with two clear side-by-side actions 我的报名 and 我发起的 (no metrics); four utilities arranged as generous plain rows with very sparse separators. Detail structure: title first on white below safe nav, category and small tag row; two-photo horizontal gallery220px high (wide main + narrower secondary) with no text on photos; time/location in spacious vertical rows; host identity simple bottom inline; one pale-blue short application-rules panel explaining review/public location. Footer same free + orange apply. Most restrained composition, not a dense boxed dashboard.
